PERMIT DOCUMENTATION CHECKLIST BUILDING & ZONING DEPARTMENT Madeira City Hall is the primary municipal location for Building & Zoning services. This checklist summarizes the documentation typically required for common permit types. Requirements may vary by project scope; staff may request additional information. Applicants should contact the Building Department early in the planning process. Madeira City Hall • 7141 Miami Avenue, Madeira, OH 45243 • Phone: (513) 561-7228 • www.madeiracity.com 1.
